name: Simple Comment Notify
description: Notifies the site administrator by e-mail or telegram about new comments on the site.
project_description:
This module has a new version with Drupal 11 support , please use it instead. 
 
 
 
 Simple Comment Notify is a lightweight tool to send notification e-mails to admins/moderators about new, published comments.

 Module can send e-mails to 
 
 admin (user with id=1) 
 users with specific role(s) 
 custom list of emails 
 
 Module can send message to telegram users! 
 Similar projects for Drupal 8 
 
 Simple Comment eMail Notification. - sends mail to site's e-mail address only 
 Comment Admin Notify. - seems like this project is abandoned 
 Comment Notify. - send mail to site users, not to site admin/moderator 
 Rules - heavy solution to send emails
